cases.title: Transport-independent canonical semantics
cases.stimulus: Supported HTTP/MCP/CLI/GraphQL surfaces use the same canonical IDs, applicability/status semantics and mutation authority.
cases.expected: Obligation holds with explicit status/authority/partiality semantics.
cases.adversarial: Violate 'Transport-independent canonical semantics' under an otherwise healthy fixture; the system must expose the defect rather than infer success.
